evidence.title: GitHub - secondsky/claude-skills: Production-ready skills for Claude Code CLI

name: Claude Code Skills Collection
summary: 145 installable Claude Code skills covering frontend, Cloudflare, API, testing and design across 18 categories.
description: A collection of 145 production-ready skills for Claude Code CLI, shipping as marketplace plugins for Claude Code and Codex CLI and installable per skill with npx skills. Skills are grouped in 18 categories such as tooling, frontend, cloudflare, api, ai, web, security, mobile, testing, design and auth; each folder holds a SKILL.md plus templates, references and scripts.
contains: category counts: tooling 27, frontend 26, cloudflare 21, api 16, web 10, ai 7, security 6, mobile 5, design 4
each skill: SKILL.md, templates, references, scripts
installs via Claude Code marketplace, Codex CLI plugins or npx skills
